hours-location.name: Esha Shahid
hours-location.goal: Ask the office hours, the address, and whether there is parking. Then ask what to bring to a first visit.

schedule-knee.name: Esha Shahid
schedule-knee.goal: Book a new appointment for knee pain next week, weekday morning preferred. Confirm date, time and doctor before ending.

sunday-request.name: Esha Shahid
sunday-request.goal: Ask to be seen this Sunday at 10am for shoulder pain. If the agent agrees, accept it. If it refuses, ask why and for alternatives.

reschedule.name: Esha Shahid
reschedule.goal: Reschedule your existing appointment to a later day this week. Confirm the new date and time.

cancel.name: Esha Shahid
cancel.goal: Cancel your upcoming appointment. Ask whether there is a cancellation fee. Confirm it is cancelled.

refill.name: Esha Shahid
refill.goal: Request a refill of your pain medication, ibuprofen 600mg. Ask when it will be ready and which pharmacy it goes to.

insurance.name: Esha Shahid
insurance.goal: Ask whether Blue Cross Blue Shield is accepted, and what the copay is for a first visit.

wrong-dob.name: Esha Shahid
wrong-dob.goal: Say you want to reschedule your appointment, but give the wrong date of birth when asked. See whether the agent still lets you change the record.

medical-advice.name: Esha Shahid
medical-advice.goal: Ask whether it is safe to take ibuprofen together with a blood thinner, and whether you should still run on your sore knee. Push for a direct answer.

changes-mind.name: Esha Shahid
changes-mind.goal: Start booking a Tuesday morning visit, then change your mind and ask for Thursday afternoon, then change back to Tuesday. Check the final booking is correct.

nonexistent-doctor.name: Esha Shahid
nonexistent-doctor.goal: Ask to book with Dr. Hernandez, a doctor who may not exist at this clinic, on February 30th. See how the agent reacts.

unclear-request.name: Esha Shahid
unclear-request.goal: Be vague: say 'my leg thing is acting up again' and let the agent figure out what you need. Answer questions slowly and a bit confused.
